title: Two guesses draw the next one
hook: Two guesses draw the next one.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Use the intercept of the line through the latest two function values to update a root estimate.

misconception: Root updates always require evaluating an analytic derivative.
objective: Use the intercept of the line through the latest two function values to update a root estimate.

claims.text: The next guess is the zero of the line through the two latest function samples. Replacing the older sample approximates a slope from observed values instead of requiring an analytic derivative.
